dataset: World Bank Worldwide Governance Indicators (WGI), six governance dimensions
license: World Bank WGI, CC BY 4.0, attribution required
retrieval_method: direct HTTPS GET to the World Bank API v2 (urllib, User-Agent AMFE-research/1.0); no scraping of pages; 6 requests, 1.2 s apart

coverage.year_rule: latest year with all 20 countries and all 6 indicators non-null is 2025; the task text named a 2023 file, but at retrieval the API already publishes 2025 -- the pinned file is named by the actual year for auditability

unit: WGI governance estimate, approximately -2.5..+2.5 (higher = better governance)

indicators.indicator_name: Voice and Accountability - Governance estimate (approx. -2.5 to +2.5)
Rule of Law - Governance estimate (approx. -2.5 to +2.5)
Control of Corruption - Governance estimate (approx. -2.5 to +2.5)

code_note: current WGI codes are GOV_WGI_*.EST (source 'Worldwide Governance Indicators'); the older VA.EST/PS.EST/... codes are archived in 'WDI Database Archives' and their data endpoint no longer serves series. Political stability is GOV_WGI_PV.EST (the old PS.EST code was renamed/archived). The six dimensions map one-to-one to the block's keys voice/stability/effectiveness/regulatory/rule_of_law/corruption.
notes: WGI estimates are perceptions aggregated from surveys/expert assessments, not a factual measurement of institutions
annual estimates are revised between WGI editions; this pin is a single year, not a PIT/vintage series
the file is a compact aggregate for the optional block-15 calibration mode; not a country ranking and not an admission input
raw values are pinned here with CC BY 4.0 attribution to the World Bank; block reports contain only 0-100 indicators and sanitized provenance
no paid licences used; source class S1 (open, CC BY 4.0)
attribution: Source: World Bank, Worldwide Governance Indicators (WGI), CC BY 4.0
